problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages for a shipment. Available packages are:
* Package 1: volume 47 m³, revenue $275
* Package 2: volume 45 m³, revenue $293
* Package 3: volume 26 m³, revenue $152
* Package 4: volume 14 m³, revenue $50
* Package 5: volume 28 m³, revenue $21
* Package 6: volume 35 m³, revenue $254
* Package 7: volume 46 m³, revenue $185
* Package 8: volume 48 m³, revenue $11
* Package 9: volume 13 m³, revenue $161
* Package 10: volume 49 m³, revenue $224
* Package 11: volume 29 m³, revenue $273
* Package 12: volume 45 m³, revenue $155
* Package 13: volume 5 m³, revenue $29
* Package 14: volume 6 m³, revenue $187
* Package 15: volume 25 m³, revenue $221
* Package 16: volume 25 m³, revenue $128
* Package 17: volume 19 m³, revenue $258
* Package 18: volume 26 m³, revenue $293
* Package 19: volume 1 m³, revenue $232

The cargo plane has a maximum capacity of 372 m³. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package must be either fully accepted or rejected.
